users.contract: Keep current ids, mobile login and four roles/capabilities; source UUID versus Prisma TEXT/uuid client default is an explicit storage deviation, not type parity. Email optional contact until separately verified/unique; pending/active/blocked and OTP/session are domain transitions.

services.contract: ServiceLine consolidates source services; fixed/formula/manual_quote not interchangeable. Missing source surcharge/sort fields have explicit versioned target disposition; current0/30/80 estimate is not binding policy snapshot. Preserve inactive/history and old order form/specification.

orders.contract: Twenty-state machine supersedes simple source statuses without dropping quote/QC/revision/dispute. Keep all ids/codes DEC07; final price integer Toman server-owned, snapshots immutable; missing deadline/base/surcharge/notes target additive and old unknown stays unknown.

order_files.contract: OrderFile metadata references owned uploader/order and clean scan. Storage key not public URL; source URL fields transform to authorized short-lived grants. Content/role-kind/assignment/visibility checks cannot be replaced by FK or MIME string.

order_messages.contract: OrderMessage scoped to order, actual sender and customer_visible/internal_only enum; source is_internal Boolean requires explicit transformation. Attachment URL becomes owned clean OrderFile FK; no client author/role injection.

payments.contract: Payment callbacks verify stored authority/amount/provider and payload-bound idempotency. Single transaction/ledger proof, late money reconciliation and immutable order amounts; source status/provider strings translated deliberately, live acceptance deferred.

wallets.contract: Wallet.balance is integer cache derived from balanced append-only Ledger, not mutable user credit. Currency IRT/Toman explicit; source defaults never justify funding account. Charge/spend/reserve target DEC06 with no negative/race/replay acceptance inferred.

tickets.contract: Own optional order/public handler; assigned support with separate actor. New target first meaningful public response4 working hours under versioned Sat-Thu09-18 Tehran calendar; old SLA unchanged. Missing sla_hours/customer_rating are explicit future fields/relations, not existing behavior.

ticket_messages.contract: Customer public message vs assigned support internal/public reply; enum visibility transforms source Boolean. Attachments owned/clean and projected safely; meaningful public first response distinct from bot/internal note. Real server reason/body normalization still target.

reviews.contract: Feedback consolidates order/team/executor/support/QC rating/complaint/thanks; rating1..5 integer DTO is not proof of DB CHECK. Source is_public DEFAULT TRUE overridden by approved optional moderated publication DEC03; never mass-publish legacy feedback or leak staff internal id.

notifications.contract: NotificationLog + Outbox + preference/channel delivery separate source notification concept; sentAt/readAt/provider delivery not interchangeable. Typed consent, dedupe retry/dead-letter and safe payload; GET defaults not proof of live Push/SMS/email.

ledger_accounts.contract: Unique owner or typed system account, explicit null owner/system semantics; account_type enum not arbitrary 'wallet' alias. No auto historic account repair; approved missing-account packet only diagnoses nonzero cache discrepancy.

ledger_entries.contract: Positive amount/distinct debit-credit accounts/restrict FK and append-only triggers in migration, wallet projection tx, created_by alias, currency/reference/idempotency semantics explicit. Current correction fingerprint/lineage gap and reconciliation force cache remain open; never update/delete old journal.
